newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share prices end lower.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share prices end lower.

text.p: The Jakarta Composite Index closed virtually unchanged after a volatile day on Thursday despite heavy profit-taking in blue chip Telkom by mainly foreign traders, brokers said.

The index closed down 0.04 points, or 0.01 percent, at 663.13 points, after touching a high for the day of 668.76. Its low for the day was 660.96. Gainers led losers by 58 to 48, with 73 counters unchanged.
Total turnover was 481.7 billion rupiah on a volume of 205.5 million shares.

Telkom, the heaviest weighted issue on the exchange, announced slightly higher than expected profits for 1996 of 1,503 billion rupiah, compared to a market expectation of 1,454 billion rupiah, brokers said.

The stock rose sharply after the announcement, but then slipped back on foreign profit-taking to close 25 rupiah lower at 3,725 rupiah on a turnover of 26 milliin shares, making it the most active stock through the day.
It also cross traded at 3,700 rupiah on 12 million shares.
Brokers said weak regional markets had contributed to volatility on the Jakarta exchange through the day.
